video_title: Philadelphia 76ers Postgame Media Availability 🎙️ | Tyrese Maxey and Labaron Philon Jr. | 10.16.26

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on the 76ers' ongoing chemistry development
quotes.excerpt: I think it's still going to take some time. We got a lot of different guys.
quotes.quote: I think it's still going to take some time. We got a lot of different guys than we did last year, a lot of guys who do a lot of different things, so it's definitely going to take some time.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey says the 76ers roster turnover means it is still going to take some time for the team to find their chemistry.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on Joel Embiid's floor spacing through three-point shooting
quotes.excerpt: He's going to get them, they're going to give them to him, so he's just need to shoot.
quotes.quote: He's going to get them, they're going to give them to him, so he's just need to shoot them. I think he's a good shooter, so the more threes he takes will be the better for us.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey wants to see Joel Embiid shooting more threes this season saying the more he takes the better it will be for the team.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on LeBron James taking charges in the preseason
quotes.excerpt: See a guy who's 41 still taking charges in preseason games.
quotes.quote: See a guy who's 41 still taking charges in preseason games. We had a practice, it was a late game situation and he was standing there and he moved out the way so I got charged when we get to the game and he took it.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey shares a funny story about LeBron James taking charges during preseason games at age 41.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on his adjustment to the NBA preseason
quotes.excerpt: It's been great being able to experience my first kind of NBA preseason.
quotes.quote: It's been great being able to experience my first kind of NBA preseason and then playing with the guys on the first unit with LeBron, JB and all those guys, they just make the game so easy.
quotes.social_post: Rookie Labaron Philon Jr. says playing with veterans like LeBron James and JB makes the game so easy for him during his first NBA preseason.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on his development of court vision and playmaking
quotes.excerpt: Having the feel of the game, knowing where the defender at at all times.
quotes.quote: Having the feel of the game, knowing where the defender at at all times and knowing how to read the pick and roll really. LeBron clicked them on the pick and roll on the side and I got to the middle and got an easy look at the shot.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. credits his development to learning how to read the pick and roll and understanding where defenders are at all times.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on maintaining patience as a rookie guard
quotes.excerpt: First trusting in your work and then second, just being patient, letting the game come to you.
quotes.quote: First trusting in your work and then second, just being patient, letting the game come to you, not trying to force shots. I think I shot two free throws before I even scored a real basket, so it was just letting the game come to me, not trying to rush things.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. on his approach as a rookie guard saying he is focused on trusting his work and letting the game come to him.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on the 76ers' need for more catch-and-shoot opportunities
quotes.excerpt: Offensively, I would say really just being able to shoot more catch and shoots.
quotes.quote: Offensively, I would say really just being able to shoot more catch and shoots and that's for everybody on the team. We kind of catch and hold it a little bit, but I would say that kind of mix in with the chemistry and gelling together.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. notes that the 76ers need to improve their offensive flow by taking more catch and shoot opportunities instead of holding the ball.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on the importance of training camp experience
quotes.excerpt: Being able to experience all the things that go on before training camp like summer league.
quotes.quote: Being able to experience all the things that go on before training camp like summer league and stuff like that. Being drafted, it was grateful, but I would say really it was a quick turnaround and they told me that I didn't really believe it but they said it happened fast.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. reflects on his rapid transition to the NBA saying the turnaround from being drafted to training camp happened fast.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on learning to play against bigger players
quotes.excerpt: Playing against taller and bigger players when I was really young.
quotes.quote: Playing against taller and bigger players when I was really young and it was kind of hard for me to get on the court, but I feel like I learned how to play the game and not just try to rush things. I make some moves and make it look like I'm rushing a little bit, but I know how to slow it down and know where the reads at.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. says learning to play against bigger players at a young age helped him develop the ability to slow the game down and make the right reads.
